skill.name: code-review-assistant
skill.description: AI-assisted pull request review for security, performance, best practices, and review reports.
skill.summary: Review pull requests with structured AI guidance.
skill.author: Hermes-Sedimentary

security_audit.summary: The static entropy finding is a false positive caused by a short Markdown file with non-English text and symbols. No scripts, network calls, external commands, hidden payloads, or prompt injection attempts were found in SKILL.md.

static_findings.pattern: [HEURISTIC] High file entropy (6.24 bits) - possible binary/encrypted content

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md is a readable 34-line Markdown file with metadata and usage notes. The higher entropy is explained by Chinese text and symbols, with no binary, encrypted, or encoded content.

content.user_title: Review Pull Requests with AI Guidance
content.value_statement: Code reviews can miss security, performance, and maintainability issues. This skill helps Claude, Codex, or Claude Code produce structured review feedback.
actual_capabilities: Guides AI-assisted review of pull request code.
Directs attention to security review concerns.
Directs attention to performance analysis concerns.
Suggests best practice improvements for submitted changes.
Helps structure findings into a review report.
limitations: It contains written guidance only, with no scripts or automated scanner.
Review quality depends on the code and context provided.
Human review is required for critical outputs.
It does not replace project tests or dedicated static analysis.

use_cases.title: Review a Pull Request
use_cases.description: Check a proposed change for defects, risks, and maintainability concerns before merge.

use_cases.title: Prepare Team Feedback
use_cases.description: Create clear review comments that help a teammate improve a change.

use_cases.title: Screen Security and Performance
use_cases.description: Use an initial AI pass to surface security and performance topics for deeper review.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this pull request for correctness, clarity, and maintainability. List the most important issues first.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small change

prompt_templates.title: Security Focus
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this change for security risks. Look for unsafe input handling, secret exposure, access control problems, and risky dependencies.

prompt_templates.title: Performance and Practices
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this pull request for performance concerns and best practice gaps. Include specific review comments and suggested fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Release Readiness Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a senior review of this pull request. Assess correctness, security, performance, test coverage, operational risk, and merge readiness.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before a high-impact merge

output_examples.input: Review a pull request that changes authentication behavior.
output: High priority: Verify that failed login attempts do not reveal account status.
Medium priority: Add tests for expired sessions and repeated login failures.
Question: Should this change update the security documentation?

output_examples.input: Review a pull request that adds a new data processing path.
output: Performance concern: Confirm that large inputs are processed without blocking shared resources.
Best practice: Add clear error handling for malformed input.
Merge readiness: Request tests that cover normal, empty, and invalid data.

best_practices: Provide the pull request diff and the intended behavior.
Ask for prioritized findings with severity and rationale.
Verify important findings with tests or a human reviewer.
anti_patterns: Do not merge changes based only on AI review output.
Do not omit project context when requesting a review.
Do not treat broad comments as substitutes for concrete tests.

faq.question: What does this skill help review?
faq.answer: It helps review pull request code for security, performance, best practices, and report quality.

faq.question: Does it run an automated scanner?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides written guidance for AI-assisted review and includes no executable scanner.

faq.question: Can it replace a human reviewer?
faq.answer: No. The skill states that important outputs should be checked by a human reviewer.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: What context should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the pull request diff, the goal of the change, related tests, and known risk areas.

faq.question: Is it suitable for small teams?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill names individuals, freelancers, small businesses, and teams as target users.
